name: Core C API and Runtime
description: Engine-neutral C interfaces, shared geochemical containers, lifecycle helpers, constants, diagnostics, and process-wide error handling form the foundation used by every adapter and driver.

name: Reaction Engine Adapters
description: PFLOTRAN, CrunchFlow, and ONNX implementations translate the generic Alquimia contract into engine setup, reaction stepping, state conversion, metadata, and inference operations.

name: Fortran Bindings
description: ISO_C_BINDING container mirrors, string conversion utilities, and an object-oriented Fortran facade expose the core C contract safely to Fortran callers.

name: Mixed-Language Examples
description: Focused C++ and Fortran experiments demonstrate string exchange, derived-type layout compatibility, and pointer-backed structure-array ownership across the language boundary.

name: Driver Applications
description: Standalone batch-chemistry and reactive-transport programs coordinate input parsing, engine execution, numerical transport, output serialization, and runtime diagnostics.

name: Build and Project Support
description: CMake and Make rules select engine integrations, build and install libraries and drivers, compile interoperability experiments, and preserve third-party licensing terms.
